title: Happy red panda
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='30' r='11' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='30' r='11' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='30' r='6' fill='#f7d6c4'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='30' r='6' fill='#f7d6c4'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='27' ry='24' fill='#e05a34'/>
  <!-- white face patches -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='48' rx='11' ry='10' fill='#fbe6d4'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='48' rx='11' ry='10' fill='#fbe6d4'/>
  <!-- forehead marking -->
  <path d='M50 26 q-8 10 0 16 q8 -6 0 -16z' fill='#fbe6d4'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#fbe6d4'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='47' r='4' fill='#3b1d12'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='47' r='4' fill='#3b1d12'/>
  <circle cx='39.5' cy='45.5' r='1.4' fill='#bfe8ff'/>
  <circle cx='63.5' cy='45.5' r='1.4' fill='#bfe8ff'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#3b1d12'/>

  <path d='M50 57 q-6 7 -11 2' fill='none' stroke='#3b1d12' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 57 q6 7 11 2' fill='none' stroke='#3b1d12' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='56' r='5' fill='#f4877a'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='56' r='5' fill='#f4877a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#e05a34'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='88' r='6' fill='#3b1d12'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='88' r='6' fill='#3b1d12'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 80 q16 -4 14 12' fill='none' stroke='#c0392b' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 80 q16 -4 14 12' fill='none' stroke='#fbe6d4' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-dasharray='3 6'/>
